attempts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create the next sheet in an existing collectible 3D printed desk toy design series. Reference image 1 is the current ChatGPT app icon with the interlocking six-loop OpenAI knot, reference image 2 is the previously approved orange Clawd companion toy style. Transform these references into FOUR new physical sculpture design alternatives, not a screenshot. Landscape 3:2, 2x2 layout, warm cream background, gentle studio light, beautiful tactile matte PLA/vinyl appearance, visually matching reference 2. Exact heading 'CHATGPT / COMPANIONS'. Four individual panel IDs D1, D2, D3, D4, never A B or C. Each figure fully visible and separate. Reference 2 is for material/cuteness and Clawd identity only; no blue Codex symbol, no >_ glyph anywhere.
D1 upper left 'D1 MOCHI KNOT': a freestanding dimensional ivory-white ChatGPT knot sculpture made from six thick marshmallow-soft rounded interwoven ribbons. Keep the exact recognizable six-fold knot layout, central hexagonal opening, ribbon overlaps and negative spaces of reference 1. Treat it as a chubby rounded miniature sculpture, not a flower with solid petals. Mounted upright in a very low charcoal saddle plinth, stable physical contact. No eyes or limbs. Charming like a mochi braid.
D2 upper right 'D2 LITTLE GPT': a thick ivory rounded-square app icon has become a tiny seated desk companion, with two short thick rounded ivory legs dangling forward off a low warm-gray block. A faithful black ChatGPT knot in relief fills the front of the white tile. Very short tiny side arms resting on the seat, no added eyes or mouth on the logo. Gently tilt the tile to convey shy cuteness. Maintain central hexagon and six ribbon structure.
D3 lower left 'D3 CLAUDE HUG': the adorable terracotta Clawd from reference 2 is hugging a chunky ivory rounded pillow-shaped medallion carrying the faithful black ChatGPT knot. Its two black square eyes peer over the cushion, its orange short chunky arms embrace it, its stubby orange feet and bottom of cushion touch the floor. Intimate and sweet, broad orange rectangular torso with softened corners, no ears no nose.
D4 lower right 'D4 BEST FRIENDS': a small rounded terracotta Clawd with simple square black eyes and squat feet leans its head against a taller white rounded-square ChatGPT app-icon tile. Tile has faithful black ChatGPT knot on its front; no additional face. Both stand together on one low charcoal oval base. Clawd one third smaller than tile. Simple affectionate pose, clear silhouette, exactly two objects on shared base.
Put the exact D1-D4 names below the objects in restrained crisp black sans-serif. No extra labels or dimensions, no props, no watermarks. Rounded robust forms suitable as design ideas for palm-sized 3D prints, no thin detached parts, no floating geometry. Actual topology and printability not a technical diagram. Preserve source knot identity especially number of six loops, avoid approximating it with infinity signs or a generic rosette. The black white orange and warm gray palette should be coherent.

Edit this concept sheet to repair ONLY its background and label legibility. Preserve all FOUR figurines, their shape, material, pose, relative scale, layout and camera angles unchanged. Replace the entire dark/transparent background including black edge vignette with a fully OPAQUE uniform warm cream studio background #F7F2EA, with small gentle gray contact shadows directly beneath each object. NO transparent pixels, NO black background, NO dark vignette, NO halos or glow. Use bright even studio light. Make every black label clearly readable. Top heading exact text 'CHATGPT / COMPANIONS'. Beneath upper left 'D1 MOCHI KNOT'; beneath upper right 'D2 LITTLE GPT'; beneath lower left 'D3 CLAUDE HUG'; beneath lower right 'D4 BEST FRIENDS'. All labels need generous cream space around them. Do not crop. Keep original landscape 3:2 size. This is the final light-background sheet, with exactly the same four cute sculptures.
attempts.result: Selected; bright readable labels. Stylized knot is not a manufacturing contour.

attempts.prompt:

Reference image 1 supplies ChatGPT's black interwoven SIX-LOOP knot logo with the central hexagon and six rounded angular interlaced ribbons. Reference image 2 supplies the established warm light cream studio presentation and toy-scale material, only use for look and feel; do not repeat its sculptures. Four clearly different physical 3D-printing concept objects. Fully OPAQUE LIGHT CREAM BACKGROUND (#F7F2EA) from edge to edge, no transparency, NO black vignette, no dark halo, soft small grounded contact shadows, bright diffuse studio light, restrained black clean labels with strong contrast and generous whitespace.
Upper left 'D5 CHAT BUBBLE': a freestanding ivory speech-bubble-shaped plaque, pillowy rounded rectangular body and short thick pointed speech tail lower left, the black ChatGPT knot logo proudly in shallow relief centered on the front. Thick slab visible in 3/4 view. It nests into a small charcoal foot that provides stable contact, tail integrated into body not floating. No face, no extra lettering.
Upper right 'D6 MONO COIN': a warm light gray circular medallion lying nearly flat on the table, tilted camera to show front, same-color elevated ChatGPT knot bas-relief with clearly readable recesses and interweaving, thick smooth circular rim. One material, one color, matte gray PLA, no black paint. Clean sophisticated palm-sized coin, no lettering.
Lower left 'D7 WOOD SEAL': a substantial dark reddish rosewood-color circular medallion standing upright in a tiny matching wooden saddle. Same-color carved ChatGPT knot bas-relief on face, its angular ribbon form and six-loop interlocking pattern readable from shadows, subtle realistic fine wood-filled PLA texture rather than photographic tree rings, chamfered edge. A quiet Japanese carved-wood ornament, not a rubber stamp or ink pad.
Lower right 'D8 POCKET PEBBLE': a chunky smooth flat-bottom charcoal pebble/palm-stone, a rounded oblong form resting horizontally directly on table, with a crisp ivory ChatGPT knot inlaid on its upper gently domed surface. Soft corners, tactile worry-stone appearance, broad top, more rounded and thick than a coin, gentle 3/4 top view. No actual fingers or hands and no medical claims.
Exact four labels beneath items: 'D5 CHAT BUBBLE', 'D6 MONO COIN', 'D7 WOOD SEAL', 'D8 POCKET PEBBLE'. All visible. Do not print labels on objects themselves. Beautiful professionally rendered tangible design proposals, pleasing proportions and minimal detail. Match ChatGPT's six-part knot on all four; not Codex and NO >_ terminal glyph, no generic flower, no seven loops, no eyes, no props, no watermarks. Objects should be different silhouettes: speech bubble, flat gray disk, upright wood disk, dark horizontal pebble.
